record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain the existing pairwise softplus plus 0.2-weighted pointwise logistic objective, but weight valid targets by exp2(-d/8), where d is their distance from the final nonpadding target in the sampled sequence. Normalize by the sum of valid weights. This may align supervision more closely with next-item evaluation while retaining earlier transitions. Change only loss weighting; preserve sampling, embeddings, GRU, readout, scoring, optimizer and training limits.

category_rationales.rationale: Apply an eight-position recency half-life to the existing pairwise plus 0.2-weighted pointwise objective across all four datasets.
